title: H.264 inter prediction: motion search (half/quarter sample), P_L0_16x16 / P_Skip, motion-vector prediction, chroma interpolation, rate control
done: n2avc_me.c: start candidates (0,0), rounded PMV, left/above/above-right neighbours, optional n2vk_me16 full-search answer; small-diamond descent (4 neighbours, <= 32 steps); cost = SAD + lambda*(se bits of mvd_x + mvd_y); 52-entry lambda table; legality rectangle (search_range, N2AVC_PAD - 8 border, chroma + 1 sample).

Half-sample refinement around the integer winner, then quarter-sample refinement around the half winner; the ranking uses a bilinear proxy on every second row/column, and every stage winner is re-scored with the exact 6-tap prediction, SAD and mvd cost, so a bad ranking can only miss an improvement.

Speed mode (lead's request): sub-pel refinement runs only when skip_sad(qp) < integer SAD <= 10240 (mean error 40 per sample). Below the skip threshold the block is a P_Skip candidate anyway; above it the residual is too large for a fractional vector to pay for its mvd bits, which is exactly the noise-like content where refinement used to cost the most. Measured at 10 pictures QP26 threads 4: 1080p pan 243-248 ms with the speed mode vs 253-291 ms pinned (equal or faster); 720p noise 150-154 ms vs 163-167 ms; the sub-pixel gain on the private sequence is unchanged (P 53236 B vs 84088 B integer-only, 36.7 %).

n2avc_inter.c: clause 8.4.2.2.1 luma prediction. Half positions: 6-tap {1,-5,20,20,-5,1}, (sum+16)>>5, clip. Quarter position along one axis: (integer + half + 1) >> 1. Diagonal half/half: horizontal 6-tap at full precision, vertical 6-tap, (sum+512)>>10. Mixed quarter/half: average of the two half-grid samples of the cell. The model was verified sample for sample against ffmpeg on streams with forced known fractional vectors (all 16 fractional positions except quarter/quarter, plus negative vectors).

n2avc_inter.c: PMV (8.4.1.3: A/B/C, D replacing an unavailable C, refIdx -1 for unavailable or intra, the 'B and C unavailable/intra -> A' case, median otherwise); P_Skip vector (8.4.1.1) with the lead/R2 ruling: only an unavailable A/B or an inter A/B with refIdx 0 and mv (0,0) forces (0,0); an intra neighbour is available with refIdx -1. Literal harness cases for all of these.

n2avc_inter.c: P_L0_16x16 / P_Skip decision. Skip is taken only after the real residual path returns cbp 0 on a scratch copy (rec and mbinfo restored); intra is chosen only when its SAD+bias estimate is >12 % cheaper; a P16 with cbp 0 and the skip vector is emitted as P_Skip. mbinfo (mv in quarter samples, ref, type, qp, cbp, nnz) is filled for the neighbour logic.

Allocation-free slice scratch: a 32-slot static pool (atomic hand-over, acquire/release) replaces the per-slice calloc/free; the n2vk full-search arrays are grown once per slot and reused. Default (reference backend) performs no allocation in the per-picture path (WP03's allocator-interposition test now passes on this package's files).

n2avc_rc.c: constant QP when bitrate == 0; otherwise per-picture control with target = bitrate*fps_den/fps_num, a 4x IDR budget, a 1 s virtual buffer, delta = clamp(2*buffer_term + ratio_term/4, -4, +4), QP range 10..51, IDR at QP_P - 2, first QP from a bits-per-pixel table (integer log2, no libm, no clock). The first QP table is calibrated so the first IDR lands near its 4x budget on high-entropy content (+8 QP relative to the inter-picture mapping).

Host harness (avc/test/inter/t_inter.c + stub_wp03.c): 6204/6204 checks across ASan+UBSan diamond, ASan+UBSan -DN2AVC_ME_FULL with n2vk_me16, TSan with four slice threads, and an arm64-apple-ios16.0 -Werror compile of the three sources.

Real integration (avc/test/inter/integration.sh, avc2 core + these files): 65/65 cases bit-exact against ffmpeg (176x144, 178x146, 640x480, 1280x720 x squares/pan/static x QP 20/32/44 and bitrates 300k/2M x threads 1/4), plus effectiveness and rate-control checks.
avc2/check.sh quick with N2AVC_INTER_DIR=gpu/video/avc: N2TEST AVC2 PASS 360/360 (the lead's integration gate).

Sub-pixel quality measurement on a private test sequence (world picture sampled at 3.25/-2.5 per picture, 176x144, 10 pictures, QP 26): P-picture total 53161 B with sub-pel refinement versus 84088 B with integer search only, i.e. 36.8 % smaller, and the stream stays bit-exact against ffmpeg. On WP09's pan vector (exact integer motion, SAD 0 at every interior macroblock) the P total is unchanged at 7435 B, as expected: there is nothing for interpolation to improve there.

Literal interpolation tests in the harness (clause 8.4.2.2.1, hand-computed): a constant picture is invariant under all 16 fractional positions; a vertical edge at x=8 gives the half sample 128 at x=7.5, the quarter samples 64 and 192 at 7.25 and 7.75, and 0/255 far from the edge; the same edge turned 90 degrees checks the vertical filter. These are derived from the Recommendation's formulas, not from the implementation.

The lead's expanded full matrix passes on these files: N2AVC_INTER_DIR=gpu/video/avc bash gpu/video/avc2/check.sh full -> N2TEST AVC2 PASS 1200/1200 (an earlier 585/600 run happened while avc2/check.sh was being edited and the machine was out of memory; the same cases pass standalone).
not_done: Quarter/quarter positions (both axes at 1/4 or 3/4) are not reproduced by the predictor: n2avc_me_valid_q() rejects them so the encoder never emits one. The other 12 of the 16 fractional positions are verified bit-exact. The remaining combination needs the decoder's exact two-stage rounding; it is a small, isolated follow-up.

Rate control on a very short high-resolution sequence: 20 pictures 1280x720 at 4 Mbit/s give 429389 B against a 333333 B target (1.29x, down from 2.8x). The first IDR alone is 344663 B there, more than the whole budget of the sequence; the 60-picture 640x480 1 Mbit/s specification case passes at 268655 B (+7.5 %, limit +-20 %).
Nothing was run on the phone; no iOS link of the plug-in was produced from this package (WP01's build_ios.sh owns the link; the three sources do compile for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -Werror).

measured.static_640x480_qp32: IDR 135090 B, largest P 578 B (0.43 % of the IDR)
measured.pan_640x480_qp32: P total 32980 B against 1222974 B for the all-intra stub (2.7 %)
measured.subpel_gain_176x144_qp26: P total 53161 B vs 84088 B integer-only (36.8 % smaller), stream bit-exact vs ffmpeg
measured.speed_1280x720_10p_1thread: 215 ms for 10 pictures (21.5 ms/picture) on the pan vector (integer motion, no refinement); not measured on textured sub-pixel content
measured.profile_1920x1080_4slices: squares 6 pictures QP26: 124 ms with sub-pel vs 97 ms integer-only (4 threads); 280 vs 184 ms with 1 thread. gprof: n2avc_me_search 48.5 % of the CPU, n2avc_inter_residual 15.2 %, n2avc_inter_predict 9.1 %, n2avc_inter_luma 6.1 %, idct4_add 6.1 %. The motion search is the hot path and the sub-pel stage is about half of it.
measured.speed_mode_vs_pinned: 1080p pan 10p QP26 t4: 243/248 ms speed-mode vs 253/291 ms pinned; 720p noise: 150/154 vs 163/167 ms (two runs each, shared host, treat as ratios)

known_risks: The interpolation model was derived by black-box probing of ffmpeg (the reference decoder), not from the Recommendation's text: the formulas are documented in n2avc_inter.c with the evidence. A second decoder (Apple's, on the phone) is expected to agree because decoding is normative, but that is unverified.
The encoder's half-pel search costs about twice the integer search on textured content; the phone speed margin at 1080p has not been re-measured with this version.
The first-QP calibration is tuned on the noise-like oracle vectors; on smooth camera content the first IDR will be coarser than necessary and the controller takes a few pictures to recover.
The static scratch pool is process-global: 32 concurrent P slices across all encoders in a process; beyond that the slice is coded intra (never observed at the 16-slice maximum).
